prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED PALE PERIWINKLE flat color field — think #B7C8FF,
the color of low-resistance open meaning and unclaimed semantic space
on a semantic map. The hue must read as PALE PERIWINKLE, not white, not
grey, not shelf ice blue. Clearly distinct from every physical terrain
tile while staying visually quiet. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square
edge-to-edge with this one pale-periwinkle color corner to corner — NO
drawn hex, NO paper border, NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO
symbols, NO grass, NO figures, NO script. Only the faintest paint-
texture variation within the same periwinkle hue. A semantic terrain
region-fill swatch, not an illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: bold comic-map ink-and-wash tile, pale periwinkle saturated wash filling the entire square edge-to-edge, faint brushstroke texture within the same periwinkle hue, top-down terrain swatch in luminous lavender blue

subjects.description: flat saturated pale periwinkle wash covering every corner of the 1024x1024 square, faint wet-brush texture variation within the single hue, no symbols or figures
barely-perceptible paint grain and subtle brushstroke drift within the periwinkle field, same hue throughout, no contrast elements
